kv_footprint.method: ctypes on the pinned bundle; KV = VmRSS delta across llama_init_from_model (kv_unified=True); prefill = one llama_decode of a 217-token shared prefix; warm decode = median of 5 single-token decodes
kv_footprint.finding: with kv_unified=True the measured KV is identical for n_seq_max=1 and 4: the cache is n_ctx cells shared by every sequence, exactly as S-4 hypothesised. The conservative planner charges n_ctx * n_seq_max, i.e. 4x too much at n_seq_max=4, and agrees with the measurement to 0.1% at n_seq_max=1. The recommender stays conservative (S-4) until E2.5 consumes this number.
kv_footprint.secondary: llama.cpp splits this arch into a SWA cache (27 layers) + a non-SWA cache (9 layers): at n_ctx=2048/f16 that is 216 MiB + 72 MiB = 288 MiB, matching the 302 MB measured (decimal).

cpu_baseline.caveat: the sandbox is cgroup-limited to 2 CPUs (cpu.max=200000/100000) while os.cpu_count() reports 24, so the 24-thread run thrashes and is SLOWER than threads=1. These are sandbox numbers, not this box's numbers: the [recon] host figures (prefill ~2k tokens in 5.9 s CPU = ~340 tok/s, warm decision 14-20 ms) are NOT reproduced here and remain [recon].
